subject: DPA for Redwood — initial redlines & SOC2 evidence request
messages:
From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@globexbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA for Redwood — initial redlines & SOC2 evidence request

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and routing options. Procurement/legal at Globex are ready to start the DPA review. Attaching our initial redlines for your counsel (Globex_DPA_redlines_v1.docx).

Two asks up front:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept the 24-month data retention carveout on backups?
- We also need SOC 2 Type II evidence (latest report) and the SIG response.

Timing: we are hoping to get to signature in the next 3 weeks if possible. Please let us know your proposed review timeline and how you typically route signature (DocuSign vs granular exec sign-off).

Appreciate it — copy of the security questionnaire attached as well.

Regards,
Ellie Ramos
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Globex Bank
Attachments: Globex_DPA_redlines_v1.docx, Globex_Security_Questionnaire_SIG.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@globexbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA for Redwood — initial redlines & SOC2 evidence request

Ellie — thanks for the redlines and the clear timeline. We can support a 3-week cadence; below is our proposed sequencing and asks so we align on SLAs and signature: 

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Internal review & counter-proposal (legal ops): Redwood to return a tracked proposal within 3 business days.
2) Technical evidence pack: SOC 2 Type II and SIG/CAIQ answers to be provided within 2 business days of the counter-proposal.
3) Exec/Legal sign-off: if counterparty redlines are limited to data-retention and subprocessors, we can usually handle signature via standard DocuSign route with Legal + Head of Partnerships sign-off (no board escalation). If material changes (retention >36 months or broad indemnity), we may need VP/GC approval which adds 5–7 business days.
4) Final signature and archive to HubSpot/Drive; we’ll send DocuSign link and run the standard evidence handoff.

Attachment: RW_DPA_Globex_Redlines_Proposal.docx (first pass counters with comments).

Two clarifying Qs:
- Which specific backup solution is in scope for the 24-month retention ask (primary, replica, cold storage)?
- Do you require a dedicated data residency clause (EU-only processing) or is the standard SCCs + customer controls sufficient?

I’ll loop Karthik for legal redline guidance and Neha for the evidence bundle.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: RW_DPA_Globex_Redlines_Proposal.docx

From: Marco Silva <m.silva@globexbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@globexbank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA for Redwood — initial redlines & SOC2 evidence request

Thanks Irene — quick clarifications from our side.

1) Retention carveout: this is specific to nightly backup snapshots retained in cold storage for disaster recovery (we do not expect primary replicas to be retained longer than production TTL). Our ask is 24 months for those snapshot archives only.
2) Residency: EU-only processing for Globex PII would be preferred, but we can accept SCCs if you confirm exports are only for minimal operational workflows and that subprocessor list is provided up front.

We reviewed your attachment and highlighted two clauses in the redline: retention and subprocessor notification window (we requested 30 days). We also uploaded a completed SIG excerpt in the security questionnaire (see attached: Globex_Security_Questionnaire_SIG.xlsx).

For signature: DocuSign is preferred — can you send the routing (who signs on Redwood side)? We typically set countersignature with a single GC/VP-level signatory.

Regards,
Marco Silva
Senior Counsel, Vendor Contracts
Globex Bank
Attachments: Globex_Security_Questionnaire_SIG.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene_ichoi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@globexbank.com>, Marco Silva <m.silva@globexbank.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA for Redwood — initial redlines & SOC2 evidence request

Karthik / Neha — see Globex redlines and their SIG — summary below and proposed next steps. I’m keeping Globex on copy so they see the timeline.

Summary of asks from Globex:
- 24 months retention for nightly cold snapshots only (explicit carveout)
- 30-day subprocessor notice window
- EU-only preference (SCCs acceptable with export constraints)

Proposed Redwood response (legal + ops):
- Accept 24-month backup retention carveout limited to cold snapshots; add explicit operational definition and scope.
- Offer 45-day subprocessor notice (can we meet 30 days operationally? if not, propose 45 days and include escalation path).
- Provide SCCs + commitment to provide subprocessor list at onboarding and a quarterly update. For EU-only customers wanting hard residency, we can discuss a Private deployment option (Redwood Private) as an alternative.

Next steps: 
1) Karthik: please review the attached RW counters (RW_DPA_Globex_Redlines_Proposal.docx) and confirm the 45-day vs 30-day notice trade-off.
2) Neha: please package the SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and our SIG/CAIQ answers and upload to the HubSpot deal. I will draft the DocuSign routing once we confirm signers.
3) If Karthik approves the counters, I will send the DocuSign envelope prepped for signature (exec sig + GC).

Karthik, if you can respond by EOD tomorrow we should be in range for a signed agreement by end of quarter (within their 3-week target).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
